name: pf-fix-bufftips-skill-icons
about: fix-bufftips-skill-icons against the built package qol instead of the mods' source folders (tools/make_package_scenarios.py). Issue #28, mods/bufftips: vanilla's class skill buffs with no "hud" icon (War Cry and 12 other families, SkillBuffs.as) get one, so they reach the buff bar and its tooltip. A fresh Warrior on Bandit Keep floor 0 learns and casts War Cry: the buff's def has an icon and the bar shows it as War Cry with its description; hovering it makes bufftips log the tip. bufftips.skill_icons off leaves the next cast off the bar, on puts it back. Each other family, given with gl givebuff, shows a named, described icon. Mods core + bufftips.

steps.name: War Cry and the other class skill buffs on the buff bar

steps.pattern: \[HWP:bufftips\] skill buff icons on: 31 of 31 buff\(s\) given an icon, 0 with their own, 0 missing
steps.name: every listed buff def found and given an icon
